title: kb-sprint review and close read backlog.py ops
goal: The review and close sections of .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md each run python3 _tools/backlog.py ops SP and show its output to the operator; the close retrospective takes its refused dones and failed land steps from it instead of by hand.

run: import re,sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sec={s.split(chr(10),1)[0].split()[0]:s for s in re.split(r'(?m)^## ',t)[1:]};miss=[n for n in ('review','close') if not re.search(r'backlog\.py ops\b',sec.get(n,''))];print('kb-sprint sections without backlog.py ops:',miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
